status: post-hoc exploratory controls; no hyperparameter selection

methods.mode_aware: original 11-feature mode-probability ranker; nested OOF mode scores
methods.length_conditioned: same 11-feature function replacing mode score by training-only empirical CDF of log1p command count; labels are not used to construct this scalar
methods.nonlinear_similarity: 6 features [c,a,c^2,a^2,c*a,abs(c-a)] without mode score or command count
methods.common_fit: identical original training pairs, balanced logistic regression C=0.5, max_iter=3000; no feature standardization or tuning

gallery_protocols.full_gallery: same-benchmark candidates from all 40 tasks; training task traces can be negative candidates; exactly reproduces original protocol
gallery_protocols.heldout_gallery: same-benchmark candidates from the outer held-out tasks only; queries with fewer than 2 eligible candidate tasks are excluded

interpretation: These controls test whether mode-score ranking gains are specific to mode supervision, versus trace length or extra nonlinear flexibility.
The length and nonlinear rankers share the original mode-stratified training-pair sampling for fair comparison; only their input features omit execution-mode scores.
Heldout-only galleries are much smaller and may omit small benchmarks in some folds; raw metrics across gallery protocols are not comparable improvements.
Bootstrap intervals resample task-level predictions conditional on the fixed fitted folds and gallery; they do not include model refitting or candidate-gallery sampling uncertainty.
All data have already been explored; no independent final test set is claimed.
CTF task identity is a proxy, and capture modality remains confounded with execution-mode labels.
